claim_limits: No proof of trained spiking, reset behavior, event sparsity, biological fit, task superiority or scaling advantage.
No certification of original missing checkpoints or the entire original He-Xiong pricing system.
Phase h=1/16 long-horizon failure and outer coupling discrepancy remain disclosed; mathematical existence does not close all numerical accuracy questions.

manual_mathematical_review.finding: Algebra checked against current production definition; C is a residual, p is a normalized value and not a probability; C1 does not imply global C2.
manual_mathematical_review.statement: Reduced perpetual-put/residual construction and C1 boundary derivatives

manual_mathematical_review.finding: At fixed kappa both channels depend on v-q-log(beta); p_x is strictly negative at every finite margin in exact real arithmetic. This does not reduce the recurrent flow or memory state dimension.
Signs and derivatives checked. g_recovery>=g_put is sufficient for the scalar equilibrium equation to be strictly decreasing, not enforced by training and not sufficient for stability.
manual_mathematical_review.statement: Feedback signs, q/z trace and determinant, and conditional equilibrium uniqueness

manual_mathematical_review.finding: Each target lies in its coordinate interval and ETD2 predictor/final coefficients are nonnegative and sum to one. The conclusion does not certify floating-point invariance, accuracy, gradient contraction or carried states across parameter changes.
manual_mathematical_review.statement: Continuous bounded rectangle and exact-arithmetic ETD2 convex invariance

manual_mathematical_review.finding: Strictly inward rectangle plus sufficiently small outward Lyapunov ellipse gives a compact forward-invariant equilibrium-free annulus. C1 planar Poincare-Bendixson implies a periodic orbit. All hypotheses and the explicit rational Lyapunov identity were checked. No uniqueness, isolation, stability, exact period or smooth Hopf claim is made.
manual_mathematical_review.statement: Periodic orbit existence in the untrained invariant v=0 plane

manual_mathematical_review.finding: It preserves the channel bounds, nonnegative Call, zero stopped branch, and boundary first derivatives used in the proof. Thus this capacity is not evidence of an analytic-global-shape advantage.
manual_mathematical_review.statement: Matched operator admits the same periodic-orbit existence argument

manual_mathematical_review.finding: Rank-one exponential and variation of constants yield the stated division-free update for arbitrary key norm. The norm bound is conditional on identical held inputs and rates; it does not bound the full parameter gradient or full BPTT map.

Actual source advances flow first and then memory with endpoint rates. The non-writing scalar example correctly gives the Delta^2/2 discrepancy in log multiplier. Internal h refinement does not remove fixed outer-Delta splitting error. Mesh ceil-switches can change the discrete time map; fixed-dt parameter differentiation and time differentiation across switches are different claims.
